exposure: Umbilical artery (UA) Doppler flow (normal vs. abnormal indices)
outcome: Placental pathology (maternal malperfusion lesions, inflammatory responses/chronic villitis)
cohort: SGA neonates (birth-weight <10th percentile), born between 2008 and 2017, whose pregnancy and placental reports were analyzed based on umbilical artery Doppler flow status.
finding: Abnormal umbilical artery Doppler flow in SGA pregnancies is associated with earlier gestational age, higher rates of maternal placental malperfusion lesions, and adverse neonatal outcomes, while normal Doppler flow is associated with chronic villitis.
birth_weight: <10th percentile (for inclusion), <5th percentile (as an outcome/associated factor)
gest_age: Earlier gestational age at delivery (for abnormal Doppler group)
